description:
The module-PORT TEST HARNESS: install ported custom modules on a THROWAWAY database and say
    plainly whether they install (and, with with_tests=True, whether their own tests pass). Use it
    after addon_port_prepare and after every fix, before any data is moved.

    db_name MUST start with 't_' (a test database; production names are refused). fresh=True
    drops it first (dropdb --force - even if a running Odoo holds it). One test at a time per box
    (flock), --workers=0 --max-cron-threads=0, --stop-after-init. Without tests: --no-http; with
    tests: --http-port=<http_port> (HttpCase/tours need a server port that does NOT clash with the
    running service) + --test-enable --test-tags /mod1,/mod2.
    runtime='docker': runs inside `service` of the compose stack at base_dir; addons_dir (on the
    box) = copy just those module dirs into <base_dir>/extra-addons first. runtime='native':
    `odoo -c <odoo_conf>` as user odoo; addons_dir is appended to the conf's addons_path.
    Returns verdict ok/failed, the error lines, test counts and the modules-loaded line.
name: addon_install_test
